Both worked the same way once I got into it — the little pop-up came up, I changed the title and description, saved, and the card updated right away without a reload. That immediate update is what I'd want, so that behavior is good.

Between the two ways of starting: the direct "Edit" button feels more natural to me. It's right there and I know exactly what it does in one click. The "..." version made me open a menu first just to find the one thing I wanted. So let's go with the visible Edit button.

I'll mention one thing so it's not a surprise later — I know editing isn't the only thing I'll eventually do to a saved item, so whatever we land on should have room for those other actions when we get there. But for starting an edit, the direct button is the right call. This part works for me.
